verdict.rationale: Proa ships an official, cargo-installable `proa-cli`. Its documented commands cover scaffolding (`proa new site --yes`), vendoring UI components (`proa ui add`), inspecting routes (`proa site routes`), formatting checks (`proa fmt --check --verify`) and self-updates (`proa update`). For agent workflows, it scaffolds an AGENTS.md by default (skippable with `--no-agents-md`) and supports non-interactive `--yes` flags. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and evidence of machine-readable (e.g. JSON) output or other agent-specific CLI modes.
